artifacts.summary: Three sequential phases (3 h): port the compiled research prototype into the wired probe specs/evidence/seam-gluing-ray-product/node-cell-stabilization.lean with the mandated header (witness Φ, fallback D not needed, forward-only, no bound, no finiteness, Xp-not-⊡ sharpening); wire one WIRED entry into scripts/check-evidence-probes.sh (27 -> 28 probes); add one Evidence sentence to the RaySummary README and run the full gate set. Lean Challenge Statements pin preCell_stable, preCell_zero_ne, postCell_stable verbatim (block type-checks standalone).

memory_candidates.content: On a FrameOver.ofReflectiveRegular-built fixture whose carrier is a concrete inductive (e.g. NoFiniteWidth's Node), a goal mentioning `cellAt M φ (.pre k) z` or `canon k t s = .x m` has its literal at type F.WorldState, which is defeq to the carrier only at default transparency. `rw` with an iff lemma whose pattern fixes that type (`rw [mem_cellAt_iff]`, `rw [canon_eq_x_iff]`) fails with 'target expression is not type-correct under the implicit transparency level'. Apply such lemmas in term mode instead — `(mem_cellAt_iff M φ _ z T).mp hT` / `.mpr ⟨σ, hσz, rfl⟩`, `canon_eq_x_iff.mp h'` after `have h' : canon k t z = Node.x m := ...` — or ascribe the equation at the carrier type first. Rewriting INSIDE a state equation (`rw [hσ s, histOf_state, canon_of_lt h]`) is unaffected. Also at this Mathlib pin `push_neg` is deprecated; use `push Not`.
